text:
You’ve got a Python project with the code in place, but you’re running into issues and need someone to help sort them out.

I’m Tobias Reyne, and I’d be glad to step in and help you get the project stable again. I bring 7 years of full-stack experience across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, and I’m comfortable working through existing codebases, tracing problems, and making careful fixes without disrupting what already works.

While most of my recent work has been on web applications, the core of my experience is working with real production code, understanding how systems fit together, and debugging issues methodically. For example, on Charity admin modernisation for Oakfield Charities, I rebuilt donation entry screens with HTMX while upgrading a Django 1.11 donor system to Django 4.1, which reduced donation entry time by 45% and preserved zero data loss across 180k donor records. On Live fleet dashboard for Ferrylane Freight, I built a dispatcher map that showed every truck’s position and ETA as GPS pings arrived, tracking 1,800 trucks live and getting updates from ping to screen in under 2 seconds.

That kind of work has trained me to be careful with existing logic, look for the root cause instead of quick guesses, and make targeted changes that keep the application reliable. If your Python project already has the code and just needs troubleshooting, bug fixing, or cleanup, I can help review the issue, identify what’s breaking, and work through it with you clearly and efficiently.

I’m happy to collaborate however you prefer, whether that’s diagnosing a specific error, reviewing the relevant files, or stepping through the problem area together. If needed, I can also help make the code easier to maintain once the immediate issue is fixed.

What part of the Python project is failing right now: a specific error message, broken behavior, or an issue in a particular file?
